posts.title: How To Get Nail Glue Off Skin Safely
tutorial_steps: Step 1: Clip excess length and gently file down the top shiny coat to break the seal.
Step 2: Apply cuticle oil or petroleum jelly around the skin to protect from dehydration.
Step 3: Soak a cotton ball in 100% pure acetone, place over nail and wrap tightly with foil.
Step 4: Wait 15-20 minutes, then gently slide off the loosened product with an orangewood stick.
Step 5: Wash hands thoroughly and massage with rich vitamin E cuticle oil.
